description: Use this when a homeowner asks which kind of home equity product to consider (a HELOC, a home equity loan, a home equity investment or a reverse mortgage) or how they compare for their situation. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Amounts are US dollars; rate ranges are percent APRs from lenders' advertised rates; costs are interest plus fees over the time horizon. Home equity investments and reverse mortgages are explained, not priced. Each product is checked against published lender rules and the homeowner's stated preferences: estimates, not quotes, offers, approvals or a recommendation. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

amount_wanted.description: The cash the homeowner wants to receive, in US dollars. Leave out when unknown.

credit_band.description: The homeowner's own credit range: excellent 740+, good 670-739, fair 580-669, poor under 580. Leave out when unknown.

current_first_mortgage_rate.description: The first mortgage's annual rate in percent, for example 3.25.

draw_pattern.description: lump_sum: all the money at closing. staged: drawn over time, as a HELOC allows.

first_mortgage_balance.description: What is still owed on the first mortgage, in US dollars; 0 when the home is owned free and clear.

home_value_estimate.description: The homeowner's estimate of the home's value, in US dollars.

horizon_months.description: How long the homeowner expects to keep the loan, in months (12-360).

other_liens.description: Balances of any other loans secured by the home (a second mortgage or an existing HELOC), in US dollars; 0 when there are none. Leave out when unknown.

purpose.description: What the money is for. debt_consolidation also prices the cost of not borrowing. Leave out when unstated.

rate_preference.description: fixed: a payment that stays the same. either: no rate type stated.

scenario_token.description: The scenario_token of an earlier result in this conversation, as returned. It fills any answer not sent here; an answer sent here wins.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

name: compare_home_equity_products

as_of.description: Date the catalog's newest figure was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

confidence.description: high when nothing that would change the result is missing, medium when one thing is, low when more are or the state is not covered.

general_information.description: Always true: this is general information.

non_partner_options_included.description: True when the result draws on lenders that pay Alauda nothing.

not_an_offer.description: Always true: nothing here is an offer.

ranking_basis.description: How any list in this result is ordered.

who_pays_us.description: Who pays Alauda. Show it with any lender or rate information.

ignored_fields.description: Parameters dropped because they looked like an SSN or a street address, or because this tool no longer takes them: names only, the first 5.

inputs_used.description: The inputs this result was computed from.

response_requirements.description: Rules any reply built on this result keeps.

explained.description: Explained, never priced or applied for.

product.description: Also the explain topic that covers it, with its rules (a minimum age, for one) and their sources.

horizon_months.description: Months the costs cover: horizon_months as sent, or the default when none was sent.

cltv_after_pct.description: Computed by Alauda: everything owed plus the loan, over home_value_estimate, in percent. Absent without value, balance and amount.

cost_of_not_borrowing_usd.description: Computed by Alauda: for debt_consolidation, simple interest on amount_wanted over the horizon at a 22.4% card rate (the Federal Reserve G.19 average). Absent otherwise.

equity_status.description: Combined loan-to-value with the amount, against the 80% limit checked: plenty, near the limit, above it, or unknown without value, balance and amount.

keep_first_mortgage.description: true: the first mortgage's rate is below every compared option's, so borrowing separately leaves it untouched.

lowest_cost.description: Among the options not ruled out, the one with the least interest plus fees over horizon_months, and its own term: a term shorter than the horizon is repaid sooner, with a higher payment. Absent without an amount.

interest_and_fees_usd.description: Computed by Alauda: interest plus fees over horizon_months on amount_wanted, from the option's catalog rate, fees and term.

term_months.description: The option's own term in months, or the product's usual term where the lender states none. From the lender's entry in our catalog, which records no page or date for it.

options_in_state.description: Catalog entries for the product in the state.

options_not_ruled_out.description: Of those, the ones no rule or stated preference rules out.

published_rules.description: Published lender rules and stated preferences against the homeowner's answers, never an approval or a pick. none_missed: at least one lender misses no rule we can check; not_all_known: nothing rules one out yet, but not everything can be checked; outside_preferences: every lender misses a stated preference; over_limits: every lender has a limit the figures are past; not_in_state: none in the state.

rate_range.description: Lowest and highest advertised rate among the state's catalog entries for the product, each with its page and date. Absent when there are none, or when the result would not fit 2 KB with it; rates by state, with sources, are also looked up on their own.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.
Page the figure was read from.

scenario_token.description: The answers this result used, signed by Alauda (not a secret, no personal data). Pass it as scenario_token to a later call instead of repeating them; it works for 60 minutes. Absent when the result would not fit with it (often on a comparison with many answers): then pass the answers in inputs_used.

what_would_make_this_more_accurate.description: Parameter names that were not given and would change the result.

title: Compare home equity products
